```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Annotate each peak to a promoter
```{r}
d <- read_tsv("peak_to_genes.tsv", col_names = c("chrm", "peak_start", "peak_end", "peak_name", "peak_enrichment", "chrm_gene", "gene_start", "gene_end", "gene", "gene_value", "gene_strand", "distance")) %>%
    separate(peak_name, into = c("TF", "peak_id"), sep = "_") %>%
    mutate(TF = if_else(TF == "ZMO01164", "ZMO1164", TF))
head(d)
```

```{r}
md <- readxl::read_xlsx("../2022_zymo_proteins_data.xlsx")
md
```

```{r}
d <- left_join(d, md %>% select(locus_tag, simple_name, class) %>% rename(TF=locus_tag), by = "TF")
head(d)
```


```{r}
d %>% filter(abs(distance) <= 200) %>% select(-c(peak_id, chrm_gene, gene_value, gene_end)) %>%
    write_tsv("DAPseq_peak_to_gene_mapping.tsv")
```
